name: openai/tunnel-client
title: openai/tunnel-client
headline: Secure tunnel connects private MCP servers to OpenAI
lede: You can connect private or localhost MCP servers to ChatGPT, Codex, the Responses API and AgentKit without exposing them to the public internet.

effects.effect: Internal data and tools reachable by more agent surfaces
Private MCP servers become usable from hosted agent products
Less need to publish internal endpoints for agent access

possibilities.title: QA teams can let Codex debug internal staging sites without exposing them

with.title: Chrome DevTools MCP keeps trending with coding agents

possibilities.connection: Chrome DevTools MCP is becoming a standard agent tool for browser debugging, and OpenAI's secure tunnel connects private or localhost MCP servers to Codex without a public endpoint, so a DevTools server inside the network can serve a cloud agent.

possibilities.title: Accounting firms can automate legacy desktop entry while client data stays internal

with.title: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.1 Terra for computer use
Headroom compresses tool outputs before they reach the LLM

possibilities.connection: GPT-6.1 Terra is pitched as fast, broadly available computer use, the secure tunnel lets an OpenAI agent reach private MCP servers without a public endpoint, and Headroom shrinks the tool output that each step sends to the model.
